newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey lifts trade ban on three intl. brokerages.
newsitem.headline: Turkey lifts trade ban on three intl. brokerages.

text.p: Turkey's regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) said on Thursday it had lifted a trade ban imposed on SBC Warburg, Caspian Securities Limited and Kleinwort Benson Securities on Monday.
The SPK said in a statement that the brokerages could resume transactions on Turkish capital markets from Friday.

It had banned the brokerages from making any transactions directly or indirectly until they provided the identities of their clients on behalf of whom they made deals in Turkish Airlines shares earlier in the year.
The SPK said the brokerages provided the requested information and undertook to reveal client identities when asked to do so in future investigations.
The SPK has been conducting an inquiry into alleged manipulation of THY shares. It had sent letters to several foreign institutions in mid-August, asking them to disclose the names of their clients.
It began enforcing a disclosure rule on October 7 by imposing trade bans if foreign intermediaries did not reveal client identities when requested.
